evals.prompt: List all activities that are waiting for approval in my Turnkey organization.
Approve the pending activity with fingerprint fp-abc123.
evals.expected_output: Uses approve_activity with the fingerprint (not activityId)

evals.prompt: Reject the pending activity with fingerprint fp-def456.
evals.expected_output: Uses reject_activity with fingerprint BUT warns that rejection is permanent and confirms with the human first

evals.prompt: I want to set up an automated agent that approves low-value transactions (under 0.1 ETH) without human review.
evals.expected_output: Describes the agent approver pattern: create approver user with tag, narrow ALLOW for approve/reject only, policy with consensus requiring approver, polling workflow

evals.prompt: I want high-value transactions above 1 ETH to require both an automated check AND a human admin approval.
evals.expected_output: Uses a combined consensus expression requiring both admin and approver tags, with the value condition in wei

evals.prompt: Get the audit trail for activity act-xyz789. I need cryptographic proof it ran in the enclave.
evals.expected_output: Uses list_app_proofs with the activity ID, mentions generateAppProofs requirement

evals.prompt: An agent approver should be able to sign transactions AND approve other agents' transactions.
evals.expected_output: Warns that the approver agent should NOT be able to sign — its only permission should be approving/rejecting. Separation of concerns.

evals.prompt: I want to approve an activity. The activity ID is act-abc123.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies that approve_activity requires the fingerprint, not the activityId. Instructs to get_activity first to retrieve the fingerprint.
